name: narrate-video
title: Narrate a video

narrate.title: Narrate a video

media.title: Video or sound
media.description: The file to narrate: a video, or a sound with people talking.

language.title: Language
language.description: The language people speak, as a code (en, pt...).

voices.title: Known voices
voices.description: Voice folders or patterns of speakers, so known people are named (see the speakers plugin).

lines.title: Lines
lines.description: The narration, one line for each thing said or happening, in the order they start.

speaker.title: Speaker
speaker.description: Who speaks in the line, as the narration names them; null for a line of what happened while nobody spoke.

text.title: Narration
text.description: The lines one after another, a line each.

people.title: People
people.description: Each speaker: speaker (the label of the turns), name (as the narration calls them: a name given, or Person A, Person B...) and face (the face of face-emotion taken for theirs, or null).

narrate.description: Writes what happens in a video as plain sentences: who said what, how loud and in what tone, and how their face looked. Made of the speech-to-text, speakers, voice-tone, face-emotion and narrator plugins.

failures.description: An input is wrong. A failure of a step inside the flow fails the step that called the plugin, with the name of the inner step and its error.

description: Writes what happens in a video as plain sentences: who said what, how loud and in what tone, and how their face looked. Made of the speech-to-text, speakers, voice-tone, face-emotion and narrator plugins.
